subject: DI01000081

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

The algebraic sum of currents at a lumped-circuit node is zero when no net charge accumulates there.

How to apply it

  1. Mark assumed current arrows and choose incoming positive or outgoing positive consistently.
  2. Write sum of incoming currents=sum of outgoing currents;keep unknown current signs.
  3. A negative solution reverses the assumed arrow;it is not a physically negative amount of charge flow.

Validity and common mistakes

  • KCL expresses charge conservation.Use all branches connected to the same node,including sources.
Does a negative solved branch current break KCL?

No.The actual direction opposes the assumed arrow.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Lumped-circuit node પર net charge એકત્ર ન થતો હોય ત્યારે currentsનો algebraic sum zero થાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Assumed current arrows બતાવો અને incoming અથવા outgoing માટે consistent positive convention લો.
  2. Incoming currentsનો sum=outgoing currentsનો sum લખો અને unknownના signs જાળવો.
  3. Negative solutionનો અર્થ assumed arrowની વિરુદ્ધ actual flow છે;તે calculation ખોટી છે એવો અર્થ નથી.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • KCL charge conservation છે.Same node સાથે જોડાયેલી sources સહિત બધી branches લો.
Negative Current આવે તો KCL તૂટે?

ના.Actual direction assumed arrowની વિરુદ્ધ છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Incoming currents2A and3A;one outgoing branch is1A and the other is Ix.

Step-by-step solution

  1. 2+3=1+Ix
  2. Ix=4A

Interpretation and check

Check total entering5A equals total leaving5A.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Incoming currents2A અને3A છે;outgoing એક branch1A અને બીજી Ix છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. 2+3=1+Ix
  2. Ix=4A

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Total entering5A અને leaving5A સમાન છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

The algebraic sum of voltage rises/drops around a closed lumped DC loop is zero.

How to apply it

  1. Choose loop direction;crossing a source from−to+is a rise in that traversal.
  2. Across a resistor along its assumed current direction,use a drop IR;opposite traversal gives the opposite sign.
  3. Write the signed equation,solve,and substitute back to check the loop balance.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Do not change the loop direction halfway.Linked time-varying magnetic flux requires its induced emf in the circuit model;the elementary DC form assumes the appropriate lumped representation.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

બંધ lumped DC loopમાં voltage rises/dropsનો algebraic sum zero થાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Loop direction પસંદ કરો;sourceને−થી+cross કરતાં rise લો.
  2. Resistorને assumed currentની દિશામાં cross કરતાં IR drop લો;વિરુદ્ધ traversalમાં sign બદલાય છે.
  3. Signed equation લખો,solve કરો અને પાછું substitute કરીને loop balance તપાસો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • વચ્ચે loop direction ન બદલો.Linked changing magnetic flux હોય તો induced emfનો modelમાં સમાવેશ કરો;elementary DC form યોગ્ય lumped model માટે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Series elements carry the same branch current with no intervening branching;parallel elements share the same two terminal nodes and voltage.

Explanation and application

  • Series:Req=R1+R2+…;voltage drops add and the largest resistance has the largest drop for the same current.
  • Parallel:1/Req=1/R1+1/R2+…;for two resistors Req=R1R2/(R1+R2).Branch currents add by KCL.
  • For positive resistances,the series equivalent exceeds each member and the parallel equivalent is below the smallest member.A shorted branch is not an open branch.
  • Reduce only genuine series/parallel groups.Redraw and relabel nodes after each reduction instead of grouping elements by visual proximity.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

વચ્ચે branching વગરનાં series elementsમાં same current હોય છે.Parallel elements same બે nodes વચ્ચે હોવાથી તેમનો voltage સમાન હોય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Seriesમાં Req=R1+R2+…;voltage drops add થાય છે અને same currentમાં મોટા R ઉપર મોટો drop પડે છે.
  • Parallelમાં1/Req=1/R1+1/R2+…;બે R માટે Req=R1R2/(R1+R2).Branch currents KCLથી add થાય છે.
  • Positive Rમાં series equivalent દરેક કરતાં મોટું અને parallel equivalent નાના R કરતાં પણ ઓછું છે.Shorted branch અને open branch સમાન નથી.
  • ફક્ત સાચાં series/parallel groups reduce કરો.દરેક step પછી nodes relabel કરો;ફક્ત નજીક દોરાયેલા Rને group ન કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

12V across4ohm in series with a6ohm||3ohm group;ideal constant resistors.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Rp=(6×3)/(6+3)=2ohm;Req=4+2=6ohm
  2. Is=12/6=2A;V4=2×4=8V;Vp=12−8=4V
  3. I6=4/6=2/3A;I3=4/3A;I6+I3=2A

Interpretation and check

KVL gives8+4=12V;KCL gives branch sum2A.This is an analysis example,not a component-rating selection.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

4ohm સાથે seriesમાં6ohm||3ohm group પર12V છે;ideal constant R માનીએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Rp=(6×3)/(6+3)=2ohm;Req=4+2=6ohm
  2. Is=12/6=2A;V4=2×4=8V;Vp=12−8=4V
  3. I6=4/6=2/3A;I3=4/3A;I6+I3=2A

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

KVLથી8+4=12V અને KCLથી branch sum2A મળે છે.આ analysis છે,component-rating selection નથી.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

A finite voltage source Vs in series with R has the same terminal V-I relation as current source Is=Vs/R in parallel with the same R.

How to apply it

  1. Keep the same external terminal pair and source polarity reference.
  2. Move R from series to parallel or vice versa;the current arrow feeds the terminal that was positive on the voltage-source model.
  3. Analyse the unchanged external load using the equivalent;transform back only if an original internal quantity is needed.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Terminal equivalence does not imply equal current or power in internal resistors.An ideal zero-series-resistance voltage source has no finite ordinary Norton transformation.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Finite R સાથે series voltage source Vs અને same R સાથે parallel current source Is=Vs/Rનો terminal V-I relation સમાન હોય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. External terminal pair તથા source polarity reference same રાખો.
  2. Rને seriesમાંથી parallel અથવા વિરુદ્ધ ફેરવો;current arrow voltage modelના positive terminal તરફ feed કરે છે.
  3. Unchanged external loadને equivalentથી solve કરો;original internal quantity જોઈએ તો original modelનો ઉપયોગ કરો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Terminal equivalenceનો અર્થ internal Rમાં same current/power નથી.Zero-series-R ideal voltage sourceનું finite ordinary Norton equivalent બનતું નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Vs=24V,R=6ohm,load RL=6ohm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Is=24/6=4A;parallel resistance=6ohm
  2. Original load current=24/(6+6)=2A
  3. Equivalent load current=4×6/(6+6)=2A;VL=12V

Interpretation and check

The load result matches although internal resistor currents differ between models.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Vs=24V,R=6ohm,load RL=6ohm લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Is=24/6=4A;parallel resistance=6ohm
  2. Original load current=24/(6+6)=2A
  3. Equivalent load current=4×6/(6+6)=2A;VL=12V

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

બન્ને modelsમાં load result સમાન છે,પણ internal resistor currents જુદા હોઈ શકે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

For identical idealised cells of emf E and internal resistance r,the arrangement changes source voltage and effective internal resistance.

Explanation and application

  • Series aiding,ncells:Es=nE,rs=nr.Reversed polarity subtracts emf;it does not subtract internal resistance.
  • Parallel,nmatched identical cells:Es=E,rs=r/n,with equal sharing only under the matching assumptions.
  • For nsseries cells per group and npmatched parallel groups,Es=nsE and rs=nsr/np.
  • Illustrative4identical1.5Vcells:all-series gives6V;all-parallel gives1.5V;two-series/two-parallel gives3V in the ideal model.
  • Do not physically parallel unequal cells,mix chemistries or charge nonrechargeable cells.Real battery packs need manufacturer-approved protection and assembly.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Emf E અને internal R rવાળા identical idealised cellsની arrangementથી source voltage તથા effective internal resistance બદલાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • n aiding series cellsમાં Es=nE,rs=nr.Reversed polarityથી emf subtract થાય છે,internal resistance નહિ.
  • n matched identical parallel cellsમાં Es=E,rs=r/n;equal sharing matching assumptions હેઠળ જ મળે છે.
  • દરેક groupમાં nsseries cells અને npmatched parallel groups હોય તો Es=nsE,rs=nsr/np.
  • Illustrative4identical1.5Vcellsમાં all-series6V,all-parallel1.5V અને two-series/two-parallel3V ideal modelમાં મળે છે.
  • Unequal cells parallel ન કરો,chemistries mix ન કરો અને nonrechargeable cells charge ન કરો.Real pack માટે manufacturer-approved protection/assembly જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

A voltage divider follows the common current in series;current division follows the common voltage in parallel.

How to apply it

  1. Unloaded series divider:Vk=Vs Rk/(sum R).Identify which resistance the output spans.
  2. For a load across R2,use R2||RL first,then divide across that equivalent,not the original R2.
  3. Two-branch current divider:I1=It R2/(R1+R2),I2=It R1/(R1+R2).For many branches use conductance fraction.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Current through a parallel branch uses the OTHER resistance in the two-branch numerator;current prefers the lower-resistance branch,not the higher one.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Voltage division seriesના common current પરથી અને current division parallelના common voltage પરથી મળે છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Unloaded series dividerમાં Vk=Vs Rk/(sum R).Output કયા R ઉપર છે તે ઓળખો.
  2. R2 ઉપર load હોય તો પહેલાં R2||RL કાઢો;પછી તે equivalent ઉપર divider લાગુ કરો,original R2 ઉપર નહિ.
  3. બે branchesમાં I1=It R2/(R1+R2),I2=It R1/(R1+R2).વધુ branches માટે conductance fraction લો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Two-branch current dividerમાં numeratorમાં બીજો R આવે છે.ઓછા Rવાળી branchમાં વધારે current વહે છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Vs=12V,R1=R2=1kohm,RL=1kohm across R2.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Unloaded Vout=12×1/(1+1)=6V
  2. Rlower=1kohm||1kohm=0.5kohm
  3. Loaded Vout=12×0.5/(1+0.5)=4V

Interpretation and check

A divider is not automatically a regulated power supply;loading changes its voltage.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Vs=12V,R1=R2=1kohm અને R2 ઉપર RL=1kohm છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Unloaded Vout=12×1/(1+1)=6V
  2. Rlower=1kohm||1kohm=0.5kohm
  3. Loaded Vout=12×0.5/(1+0.5)=4V

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Divider regulated power supply જ છે એવું નથી;loadingથી voltage બદલાય છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

Replace a three-terminal resistor network by an equivalent with the same resistance behaviour viewed from external A,B,C.

How to apply it

  1. For delta sum S=RAB+RBC+RCA:RA=RAB RCA/S;RB=RAB RBC/S;RC=RBC RCA/S.Each star arm uses the adjacent delta pair.
  2. For star sum of products P=RA RB+RB RC+RC RA: RAB=P/RC,RBC=P/RA,RCA=P/RB.Each delta branch divides by the opposite star arm.
  3. Preserve the external labels,redraw,and then look again for genuine series/parallel reductions.

Validity and common mistakes

  • These formulas apply to the resistor network as defined;do not confuse phase labels or divide by the adjacent rather than opposite arm in star→delta.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

External A,B,C પરથી same resistance behaviour રહે તે રીતે three-terminal resistor networkનું equivalent બનાવાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Delta sum S=RAB+RBC+RCA માટે RA=RAB RCA/S;RB=RAB RBC/S;RC=RBC RCA/S.દરેક star armમાં તેની બાજુના delta Rનો product આવે છે.
  2. Star products sum P=RA RB+RB RC+RC RA માટે RAB=P/RC,RBC=P/RA,RCA=P/RB.દરેક delta branchમાં opposite star arm denominator છે.
  3. External labels જાળવી redraw કરો;પછી ફરી genuine series/parallel reductions શોધો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Defined resistor network માટે સૂત્રો વાપરો;star→deltaમાં oppositeના બદલે adjacent armથી divide ન કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Delta RAB=6ohm,RBC=9ohm,RCA=3ohm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. S=6+9+3=18ohm
  2. RA=6×3/18=1ohm;RB=6×9/18=3ohm;RC=9×3/18=1.5ohm
  3. Between A,B with C externally open:delta=6||(3+9)=4ohm;star=1+3=4ohm

Interpretation and check

Opening terminal C does not remove the internal delta path through its node.

Does externally open terminal C remove its internal delta path?

No.External disconnection is not deletion of the internal node and its resistors.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Deltaમાં RAB=6ohm,RBC=9ohm,RCA=3ohm છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. S=6+9+3=18ohm
  2. RA=6×3/18=1ohm;RB=6×9/18=3ohm;RC=9×3/18=1.5ohm
  3. Between A,B with C externally open:delta=6||(3+9)=4ohm;star=1+3=4ohm

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Terminal C external open હોય તો પણ તેના nodeમાંથી પસાર થતો internal delta path દૂર થતો નથી.

Terminal C External Open હોય તો Internal Delta Path દૂર થાય?

ના.External disconnection એટલે internal node/R delete થવા નહિ.

body.en:
Aim

Compare signed branch currents at a chosen junction.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.

Connections and terminal roles

Use a low-voltage parallel-resistor network;each measured branch current needs series insertion of the current meter with power isolated.

Supervised procedure

  1. Label junction and all current arrows on the drawing.
  2. Estimate total/branch current and resistor power from the selected safe source.
  3. Assemble the approved circuit de-energised and verify actual common nodes.
  4. Measure total and each branch using the authorised method;isolate before every reconnection.
  5. Keep source conditions stable and record signs/ranges rather than forcing equality.
  6. Compare signed current sum with zero and explain residual using uncertainty.

Observation table — blank

Trialsource VIin AIout1 AIout2 Aresidual A
——————
——————
——————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

Residual=Iin−sum Iout.Use absolute residual near zero;percentage errors need a nonzero stated reference.

Fault finding

  • Mismatch:check omitted branches,meter burden,source drift and sign convention before concluding law failure.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Chosen junction પર signed branch currents compare કરો.

Instruments અને પસંદગી

  • Intact leads,fuse તથા correct V/ohm/current socketsવાળું DMM લો.Manual limitsમાં expected value કરતાં યોગ્ય મોટી range પસંદ કરો.
  • Approved low-voltage source તથા rated resistors/leads લો.Energise પહેલાં current/resistor power estimate કરો.

Connections અને Terminals

Low-voltage parallel-resistor network લો.દરેક branch current માટે power isolated રાખીને meter seriesમાં insert કરો.

Supervised ક્રમ

  1. Drawingમાં junction તથા current arrows label કરો.
  2. Selected safe source પરથી total/branch current તથા resistor power estimate કરો.
  3. Approved circuit de-energised assemble કરીને common nodes verify કરો.
  4. Authorised methodથી total તથા branch currents માપો;દર reconnection પહેલાં isolate કરો.
  5. Source conditions stable રાખો અને signs/ranges નોંધો;જબરદસ્તી equality ન બતાવો.
  6. Signed sumને zero સાથે compare કરીને residualને uncertaintyથી સમજાવો.

Observation Table — ખાલી

ફક્ત actual readings,units,instrument range તથા uncertainty નોંધો.Notesનાં computed examples observations નથી.

Calculation અને Conclusion

Residual=Iin−sum Iout.Zeroની નજીક absolute residual લો;percentage માટે nonzero stated reference જોઈએ.

ખામીની તપાસ

  • Mismatchમાં omitted branches,meter burden,source drift,signs તપાસો;નિયમ ખોટો છે એવું તરત ન કહો.

સલામતી

Supervisionમાં approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment વાપરો.Connections/range/socket બદલતાં power OFF રાખો.Current-mode meter source ઉપર parallel ન મૂકો.

body.en:
Aim

Compare measured rises/drops around a defined DC loop.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.
  • Approved low-voltage source and rated resistors/leads;estimate current and resistor power before energising.

Connections and terminal roles

Use a low-voltage series-resistor loop;voltage measurements are across each element with the same declared traversal.

Supervised procedure

  1. Draw the loop,source polarity,current reference and traversal.
  2. Estimate drops/current and check component power limits.
  3. Assemble de-energised and have connections approved.
  4. Measure source terminal voltage and signed resistor drops with a high-input-resistance meter.
  5. Record actual simultaneous-condition values and range/polarity;do not substitute nominal source voltage.
  6. Isolate and sum the signed loop values;assess nonzero residual realistically.

Observation table — blank

TrialVs VV1 VV2 Vsigned residual V
—————
—————
—————

Record only actual readings,units,instrument range and uncertainty.Computed examples in Notes are not observations.

Calculation and conclusion

For the chosen traversal,Vs−V1−V2 should be near zero within measurement effects.

Fault finding

  • Wrong sign or excess residual:check probe polarity,wrong nodes,loose contacts and meter loading with power off.

Safety

Use approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage equipment under supervision.Power OFF before connections/range/socket changes;never place a current-mode meter across a source.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Aim

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact leads,fuse and correct V/ohm/current sockets;range chosen above the expected value within the manual ratings.

  1. Draw the loop,source polarity,current reference and traversal.
  2. Estimate drops/current and check component power limits.

  4. Measure source terminal voltage and signed resistor drops with a high-input-resistance meter.
  5. Record actual simultaneous-condition values and range/polarity;do not substitute nominal source voltage.
  6. Isolate and sum the signed loop values;assess nonzero residual realistically.
